name: Global Historical Climatology Network daily (GHCNd)
description: The Global Historical Climatology Network daily (GHCNd) is an authoritative database of daily climate records from over 100,000 land surface weather stations across 180 countries and territories, maintained by NOAA's National Centers for Environmental Information (NCEI). GHCN-Daily provides daily observations of precipitation, maximum and minimum temperature, snowfall, and snow depth, with some records extending back to the 19th century. Data are subjected to rigorous automated quality control algorithms (Menne et al., 2012) and updated daily.

publisher.name: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information (NCEI)

license.name: U.S. Government Work (17 U.S.C. 105) / Public Domain
license.notes: NOAA publishes GHCN-Daily under a U.S. Government Work public domain designation without copyright asserted by NOAA. However, because GHCN-Daily incorporates daily station feeds from national meteorological agencies worldwide via WMO data exchange, downstream commercial redistributors must verify whether source countries retain domestic rights. Users should not assume blanket worldwide commercial rights for third-party observations.
